narrative.title: The Robotic Arm Script Rewriter
narrative.scenario: Warehouse robots execute action scripts in operator-last order (`A B *` means apply the join action to A then B), but safety auditors review scripts in ordinary infix notation. The rewriter scans the script left-to-right; each operator grabs the two most recent script fragments from a clipboard and wraps them with the operator in between.
narrative.inputFormat: A string expression in valid postfix form with single alphanumeric operands.
narrative.outputFormat: Return the fully parenthesized infix expression as a string.
constraints: Operands are single letters or digits
The expression is guaranteed to be a valid postfix expression

testCases.explanation: The * joins a and b first; the + then wraps that whole group with c.
Forward scanning rebuilds the exact infix tree the prefix conversion produced in reverse.

hintLevels: Level 1: In postfix the operator arrives after its operands — both are already on the clipboard.
Level 2: The first pop is the RIGHT operand, the second is the LEFT; the wrapper puts left-operator-right.
